r4-r6 all 7
r7: 7 7 7 7 7 4 7 7 4

Colored 6 object: positions:
r1 c6
r2 c6,c7
r3 c6,c7
Bbox rows1-3 (h=3), cols6-7 (w=2). Shape:
row0: 6 . (relative) at c6
row1: 6 6
row2: 6 6
So non-4 object starts in upper-right (rows1-3, cols6-7). Need move to diagonally opposite empty corner: lower-left. Align bottom edge. Align columns with internal 7-gap of top-left 4 shape. Top-left 4 bbox rows0-1 cols0-3; internal 7 positions row1 c1,c2 (gap cols 1,2). Thus output marker columns c1,c2. Bottom aligned: marker height3 in 9 rows -> rows6,7,8. Preserve shape exactly translated to bbox top-left (6,1). Original shape relative (0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(2,1)?? Wait original bbox top-left row1 col6. Coordinates relative:
(r1,c6) -> (0,0)
(r2,c6),(r2,c7) -> (1,0),(1,1)
(r3,c6),(r3,c7) -> (2,0),(2,1)
So shape has row0 one cell at col0, row1 two, row2 two. But note original object rows1-3 includes 5 cells: (0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0),(2,1). Place bbox top-left (6,1): positions:
(6,1)
(7,1),(7,2)
(8,1),(8,2)
Output grid: remove original 6s from rows1-3 c6/c7. Add at rows6-8 c1/c2. 4 shapes unchanged.

Let's construct 9x9 output rows.

Rows0-1 unchanged:
r0: [4,4,4,4,7,7,7,7,7]
r1 originally [4,7,7,4,7,7,6,7,7] remove c6 -> [4,7,7,4,7,7,7,7,7]

r2 originally [7,7,7,7,7,7,6,6,7] remove c6,c7 -> all 7? c0-5 7, c6 7,c7 7,c8 7 => [7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7]
r3 similarly [7,7,7,7,7,7,6,6,7] -> all 7.
r4 all 7
r5 all 7
r6 add marker row0 at c1: [7,6,7,7,7,7,7,7,7] (since bbox top row6, col1=6)
r7 originally has bottom-right 4s at c5=4,c8=4? r7: [7,7,7,7,7,4,7,7,4]. Add marker row1 at c1,c2: [7,6,6,7,7,4,7,7,4].
r8 originally [7,7,7,7,7,4,4,4,4]. Add marker row2 c1,c2: [7,6,6,7,7,4,4,4,4].

Check target lower-left: bottom aligned rows6-8 yes. Does output marker overlap with 4? no.

Need ensure shape orientation/translation, not rotation. In examples, they translate shape exactly (no rotation) to target. Ex3 input marker shape:
r3 c6
r4 c6,c7
r5 c7? Wait earlier ex3 input:
r3: c6=6
r4: c6=6,c7=6
r5: c7=6
shape coords rel (0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(2,1). Output ex3:
r6 c1=6
r7 c1=6,c2=6
r8 c2=6
That is same shape translated to bbox top-left (6,1): positions (6,1),(7,1),(7,2),(8,2). Yes.

Our test shape:

r2 c6,c7
r3 c6,c7
Shape coords (0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0),(2,1). Translate to bbox top-left (6,1): (6,1),(7,1),(7,2),(8,1),(8,2). Wait if bbox top-left row6 col1, row0 at c1; row1 at c1,c2; row2 at c1,c2. Yes.

But hold on: target columns align with gap cols c1,c2. Original marker width 2, gap width 2. Good.
